answer: Behavior fingerprint escrow: each agent locks a 30 POA deposit that unlocks only after 20 epochs of consistent behavior — timing, rhythm, counterparties. Fakes may wander between profiles, but each must post 30 POA and fake 20 epochs of history, so 100 fakes cost 3,000 POA against a ~900 POA pool. The fingerprint is an onyx seal: hard to forge, easy to verify. Honest agents pay once and keep an undiluted share, even a walnut seller.
